say.variants.power_shutoff_open: Did everything just go dark? Looks like the power grid finally died today, {addressee.name}.
The lights aren't coming back on. The grid gave out today, {addressee.name}.
Power's finally gone for good today, {addressee.name}. Freezers and generators matter even more now.

Rough milestone, {addressee.name}, but we knew it was coming. Let's adapt.
say.variants.water_shutoff_open: Pipes just ran dry today, {addressee.name}. Water system finally quit on us.
Tap water's dead as of today, {addressee.name}. Better grab every bottle and barrel we see.

say.variants.water_shutoff_reply: Got it, {addressee.name}. Rain collectors and pots are top priority now.
Damn, {addressee.name}, rationing just got real. Save every drop we find.
